name: find-references
author: lumine-code
description: Highlight and list references to the symbol under the cursor.

find-references.markers.description: Reports the reference occurrence markers currently highlighted in each editor.

autoHighlight.title: Auto Highlight
autoHighlight.description: Highlight references to the symbol under the cursor automatically whenever the cursor rests. When disabled, references are highlighted only via the `find-references:highlight` command.

delay.title: Delay
delay.description: How long, in milliseconds, the cursor must rest before references are requested.

skipCurrentReference.title: Skip Current Reference
skipCurrentReference.description: Do not highlight the reference currently under the cursor.

ignoreThreshold.title: Ignore Threshold
ignoreThreshold.description: Skip highlighting when the ratio of references to buffer lines exceeds this value, e.g. when the cursor lands on a mundane token like `true`. Zero disables the limit.

splitDirection.title: Split Direction
splitDirection.description: Direction to split the active pane when the results panel opens. With `none` the panel opens in the active pane.
